title: Semantic judge verdict for rule business-decision-in-controller
description: The only response shape gates.semantic accepts. Anything else is treated as inconclusive. Cross-field rules the schema cannot express are enforced by the adapter: findings must be non-empty for violation and empty otherwise; each path must be one of the supplied files; line ranges must lie inside that file; explanations must contain non-whitespace text. There is deliberately no confidence field.
